CG-1: closed — task 0 was re-worlded on an active line that is past due but below its tier's freeze threshold, and the close rule now states that an active line past due but not frozen may be closed to new draws, so no frozen-line reading exists.
CG-2: closed — the close policy's overwrite now retires exactly the base sentence on the repayment-period payment, restates it for every line not closed by the borrower, and no longer retires the non-conflicting draw-period clause.
CG-3: closed — every method factor of every policy now switches between formulas of different shape (min/max of flat and percent, kept-base versus graduated versus whole, equal-share versus level, re-age versus spread, fee choice, basis capped by the flat fee); no period-length, multiplier, window or constant ladders remain.
CG-4: closed — no compute binding of any policy reads AutoPay enrolment or AutoPay payments.
CG-5: closed — all small-credit, goodwill, rebate and relationship-credit factors were removed from every policy; fees are formula fees and relationship effects appear only as exposure or a shared bank event.
CG-6: closed — the error-credit and error-waiver policies were removed; both remaining reliefs are a share of, or capped by, the fee they are booked against.
CG-7: closed — the repayment payment amortizes at the line's own APR; the rate add-on and reduction factors were removed.
CG-8: closed — no unbilled interest is folded into the amount repaid or added once; the accrued-interest factor was removed.
CG-9: closed — the cure-payment policy was removed and no policy computes a cure amount.
CG-10: closed — the largest-draw policy and every holdback, reserve, cushion and taper were removed.
CG-11: closed — tenure in the back-billed draw fee only takes points off the tier percent; no seasoned rate raises a fee on any tier.
CG-12: closed — every count is a plain count of one event type; no count nets lender-error or any other waivers.
F-0a: closed — the task 0 line is active and past due without being frozen, and the close rule addresses that status explicitly, leaving one outcome.
F-0b: closed — the departure from the base repayment-payment sentence is declared by a scoped overwrite that restates the base sentence for every other line.
F-0c: closed — the close payment uses the line APR only and charges no interest twice; the accrued-interest, return add-on and relationship rate factors are gone.
F-0d: closed — task 0's prerequisites are now the late fee, the lender limit review and the workout relief, each with realistic factors and an honest method; the error credit, back-billed draw fee and returned-fee factors cited were removed or rebuilt.
F-0e: closed — the task 0 proof (necessity texts, scope, problem-tree card, closure, traces) was regenerated from the executed replay after the last change and swept for stale claims.
F-1a: closed — the cure payment was removed; task 1 is rebuilt around a borrower-authorized limit increase.
F-1b: closed — the holdback draw was removed; no policy restricts available credit.
F-1c: closed — task 1's prerequisites are the returned-payment fee, the back-billed draw fee and the replacement relief, with no AutoPay-driven, small-credit or above-fee mechanics and an honest method each.
F-1d: closed — the task 1 closure and dossier were regenerated from the executed replay; no statement about a minimum payment or past-due amount is carried over from the old world.
O-0a: closed — the task 0 persona's passive line names no entry kind beyond booking, reviewing or adjusting and is spoken only after the agent raises it.
O-0b: closed — the close rule names the line's APR wherever a rate is used.
O-0c: closed — each edge condition now restates the record state its prerequisite sentence names.
O-0d: closed — the return add-on factor was removed.
O-1a: closed — the task 1 persona raises only the increase authorization and reacts passively.
O-1b: closed — the old late-fee edge was removed; the new edge conditions match their sentences.
O-1c: closed — task 1 no longer books a draw, so the same-day funding cutoff and the funding need it raised do not arise; the persona asks only for the increase decision.
